decisions.reason: Builds directly on the firm's core messaging and cloud delivery knowledge, so the firm can assimilate and improve it.
Document capture extends document workflows but requires additional OCR skills; the firm's R&D and partnerships can likely support it.
Email-fax conversion leverages the firm's existing multi-channel messaging expertise and is close to current capabilities.
Fax delivery optimization is a core feature that deepens existing fax delivery knowledge.
Sandbox protection relates to email security but demands specialised threat detection knowledge; the firm can learn, but less certainty.
